PDF to Text Extractor

Extract all text from a PDF — page by page with PDF.js — then copy it or download it as a plain .txt file.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload your PDF.
  2. Wait for the text to be extracted page by page.
  3. Read, search or copy the extracted text.
  4. Download it as a .txt file if you need it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why is my scanned PDF's text empty?

Text-based PDFs (reports, ebooks, invoices) extract cleanly. Scanned image-only PDFs contain no text data, so nothing can be extracted.

Is the text organized by page?

Yes — text is grouped by page with a “Page N” header, in the document's reading order.

Why does the text order look odd?

Tables, columns and fancy layouts may extract out of visual order — that is how the text is stored in the PDF.

Is my PDF uploaded?

No — extraction runs locally with PDF.js in your browser.
